desc: Implement solution: read N,K and edges; root at a vertex; compute parent + subtree sizes via iterative BFS/reverse-postorder; compute forced_deg per vertex (#children with sz%K!=0, plus 1 if non-root and sz[v]%K!=0); print No if any forced_deg>2 else Yes.
Verify against samples 1 (Yes) and 2 (No), and edge cases: N=1 with a path (Yes), star graphs (No), K=1 (always Yes), and max NK=2e5 for recursion/performance safety.
Confirm the forced-edge degree criterion (max forced degree <= 2 iff decomposable) via the subtree-residue argument showing component sizes are exactly K.
